Q4 and FY 2025 Update

In 2025, we deployed 46.7 GWh of energy storage products, the highest annual deployment in our history, as Megapack production ramped at our Lathrop and Shanghai factories.

We plan to bring 500 MW of additional training compute online at Gigafactory Texas next year.

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy through increasingly affordable electric vehicles and energy products.
